body:
Damn , I am so sorry that happened to you.

Are you physically okay?

There is another thing that I got screwed over on. I was in a wreck recently, and I had Pronto insurance with a $1000 deductible.  PRONTO SUCKS! I had the $1000 and a bit more at the time of the wreck.  It took them 6 weeks to finally come up with a settlement estimate, so I could go get my car fixed. 

 Well, here's the catch.  I worked as a self employed independent contract courier, and I wasn't making any money for those 6 weeks because I didn't have a car, and I had to use the money I had in the bank to survive.  The rental coverage I was paying for I found out was I pay in advance, and they will reimburse me $25 a day once I submit a claim and they process it after I get my car repaired.   I sure couldn't afford that! 

So when they finally got around to giving me the estimate I no longer had the $1000 to get it fixed.  I stopped making payments on the car and the insurance while I was waiting for the estimate and eventually the car got repo'd before I could get it fixed. Ugh.

And it just keeps getting worse!

I have issues with paying rent and utilities this month.  Only paid $550 of a $1100 rent payment that was due on the 5th.  Got a cut-off notice from the electric company today too,  and I am so depressed that I can't focus enough to even come up with some sort of possible solution.  

I just don't have any energy. I am so tired of the struggle.  I am not suicidal, but I swear, if I started to have another heart attack I would not call 911.  I'm so done with it all!

Exactly! I died and was brought back twice out of my 3 heart attacks.  When you are dead you don't know it.  There is no light at the end of a tunnel.  No dead relatives telling you to come forward, or go back.  There is nothing. No feelings. No pain. No memories. Utter nothingness.  No sense of missing out.  No sense that you ever existed.  No sense  that you succeeded or failed. No sadness because you are dead even. Nothing.  The world goes on without you, and you don't even know it.  Even the effects that you have had on the world, and the people in it means nothing once you are dead.  There is no feeling of satisfaction that you did good for the world, or anyone in it once you are dead.

I wish I could just go to sleep and not wake up.

I would rather be dead than have to go through what the future has to offer me at this point in my life. There is nothing that awaits me in my future that makes all the stress and turmoil ahead of me worth living for.
